_readme: Abstention probe set for local-packs/internal-docs/corpus (DEMOS.md, MODEL_NOTICE.md, PIKELET_CLI_SPEC.md, ROADMAP.md). cls=paraphrase avoids the source's heading/distinctive wording on purpose (measures false abstention on reworded questions); cls=direct echoes source wording (control); unsupported/nearmiss have no answer in the four files. Evidence quotes are verbatim source text (whitespace-normalized).

questions.q: Do I have to compile the WebAssembly engine myself after cloning the repo?
questions.answer: No, prebuilt WASM ships in dist/

evidence.quote: the checkout ships prebuilt WASM in `dist/`

questions.q: How many self-checks does the engine demo run and what do they cover?
questions.answer: 8 checks: determinism, deletion, compaction, export/import, self-recall, recall, stability

evidence.quote: runs 8 validation checks (determinism, deletion, compaction, export/import, self-recall, recall, stability)

questions.q: How many back-and-forth network trips does a query need with the resident-sketch layout compared to walking the graph?

evidence.quote: sequential fetch depth drops from ~11 rounds to exactly 1

questions.q: How do I keep stock levels current while the search index itself stays static?
questions.answer: catalog hydration: Pikelet is the retrieval layer while a separate catalog owns live product data

evidence.quote: Shows Pikelet as the retrieval layer while a separate catalog owns live product data

questions.q: I got a 401 when running the catalog demo, what should I look at first?

evidence.quote: check for a `.dev.vars` file in `examples/reference-worker/`

questions.q: Does the edge docs-search Worker phone home to any external service while answering a search?
questions.answer: No outbound requests at query time

evidence.quote: and calibrated abstention. No outbound requests at query time.

questions.q: What Python libraries do I need installed to run the wiki pack example?

evidence.quote: Requires Python with `torch` and `transformers`.

questions.q: How can I try the generated search endpoint locally when I don't have a Cloudflare account?
questions.answer: pass --var LOCAL_STUB_AI:1 to npm run dev

evidence.quote: `--var LOCAL_STUB_AI:1` to `npm run dev` to exercise the endpoint mechanics without a Cloudflare account

questions.q: Ports are still occupied after the test suite finishes, how do I free them?

evidence.quote: clear them with `pkill -f "wrangler dev"` and `pkill -f workerd`

questions.q: Which larger model was the small bundled encoder taught to copy?

evidence.quote: pipeline to imitate query embeddings produced by

questions.q: What are the licensing terms of the model the student was distilled from?

evidence.quote: The teacher model is published under the Apache License 2.0.

questions.q: How quickly should a first-time user get from the scaffold command to a working live search page?
questions.answer: under 5 minutes, no Python, no GPU

evidence.quote: over their own content in under 5 minutes**, with no Python and no GPU

questions.q: What file types can the scaffolder read in as content?

evidence.quote: Support markdown, MDX, HTML, and plain text sources.

questions.q: Does the site crawler obey robots rules, and how many pages will it grab if I don't set a limit?

evidence.quote: Respect `robots.txt`. Concurrency 4, per-request timeout 15s, cap at `--max-pages` (default 500).

questions.q: Roughly how long should each text piece be and how much should neighbouring pieces share?

evidence.quote: ~200–320 tokens per chunk** with **~15% overlap** between adjacent chunks

questions.q: Where on a Linux machine do the downloaded model weights end up?

evidence.quote: to the platform cache dir (`$XDG_CACHE_HOME` or `~/.cache` on Linux/macOS

questions.q: What happens when the generated assets are bigger than what the Worker platform allows?

evidence.quote: fail with guidance if it exceeds the deploy target's script-size limit

questions.q: How does the deployed worker protect itself from being paired with the wrong embedding model?
questions.answer: startup check against manifest.json; refuses with 500 MANIFEST_MISMATCH

evidence.quote: refuses to serve (clear 500 with `code: "MANIFEST_MISMATCH"`) on any disagreement

questions.q: What response do callers get when the embedding service behind the worker is unavailable?

evidence.quote: clear 503 JSON error (`{ error, code: "EMBED_UNAVAILABLE" }`), never an unhandled exception

questions.q: Realistically, how many text pieces can I fit into a free-tier deployment?

evidence.quote: a practical ceiling around **~2K chunks on the free plan, ~8K on paid**

questions.q: Why shouldn't I just grab the newest CLI release when I re-index an existing project?
questions.answer: different chunking would silently rebuild a different index under an older vendored worker

evidence.quote: with different chunking would silently rebuild a different index under an older vendored worker

questions.q: What is the project ultimately trying to become, beyond a search library?

evidence.quote: Turn Pikelet from a vector-search library into an artifact compiler and reader.

questions.q: Which data layout came out on top in the experiments on reading indexes over the network?

evidence.quote: the winning geometry is **resident sketch + fetch-to-rerank**

questions.q: Why doesn't the Pages static host return partial content for the artifact on its own?
questions.answer: Cloudflare Pages ignores Range in its static pipeline; a Pages Function restores 206 slicing

evidence.quote: Cloudflare Pages ignores Range in its static pipeline

questions.q: Which command opens the committed docs artifact from disk and searches it with lazy range reads?

evidence.quote: Opens the committed docs artifact from disk and searches it with lazy range reads

questions.q: What is the smallest browser test that creates, snapshots, restores, and searches an index?
questions.answer: Hello pack: npm run test:browser in Chromium via Vite + Playwright

evidence.quote: creates, snapshots, restores, and searches an index in Chromium via Vite + Playwright

questions.q: What exit code signals a deploy failure?

evidence.quote: `3` deploy failure (project still scaffolded; print manual deploy instructions)

questions.q: What are the default include and exclude globs in folder mode?

evidence.quote: Default includes: `**/*.{md,mdx,html,txt}`. Default excludes: `node_modules`, `.git`, `dist`, `build`.

questions.q: What is the settled comparison point recall@10 for SIFT1M u8?

evidence.quote: Settled comparison point: SIFT1M u8, `efSearch=80`, `expansionBatch=8`, `gap=65536`, parallelism 6, 95.58% recall@10

questions.q: Is the student model domain-specific to the Pancake documentation corpus?

evidence.quote: The student is domain-specific to the Pancake documentation corpus.
